title: Rental Property Deal Screener
description: Given acquisition, income, and operating expense inputs, computes NOI, cap rate, cap rate on total cost, DSCR, cash flow, cash on cash return, gross rent multiplier, and break-even occupancy, then screens the deal against five common investment thresholds.
journeys: lender pre-qualification on an investment loan
data_vintage: 2026 (all rates user-supplied; screening thresholds are conventions, not statute)
